results.reason: No individual proof candidate has accepted security and zero knowledge, so recursion, flat aggregation, and folding cannot be promoted or fully benchmarked.
Outer proof bytes, proving latency/RSS, verifier time/gas, and full proof calldata remain null; a missing proof is never encoded as zero.

Isolated nullifier, pull-credit, claim, and empty-proof calldata components are not additive substitutes for a complete verifier transaction. Active/64/96 totals and gas per withdrawal remain null with a dependency reason.
An aggregator that receives note secrets, trapdoors, Merkle paths, or raw witnesses fails SP-70 even if its gas is attractive.
A rejecting recipient could invalidate unrelated users. The retained design atomically creates pull credits; each payee claims independently and a failed claim retains credit.
Submitting an individual proof must not lock it to one aggregator. The same proof package remains usable by another permissionless aggregator or the required individual path.
SHA-256 tokens and the Foundry model binding verifier test statement binding and state semantics only; they establish no recursion, folding, soundness, post-quantum security, or zero knowledge.
Without complete settlement totals, neither the <=14M transaction gate nor <=1M at N>=16 / >=70% improvement gate can be evaluated. Aggregation cannot replace an individual withdrawal path.
